channelTitle: Before fancy hair masks, Grandma June cracked open an egg
hook: Hair feeling dry and dull no matter what you try? Long before salon treatments, this is what grandmothers used.
remedy: As an old-fashioned piece of home wisdom, working a whisked egg yolk through the hair and scalp before washing has long been used to leave hair feeling softer and shinier.
steps: Whisk one or two egg yolks in a small bowl
Work the yolk through damp hair, focusing on the ends
Leave it on for ten minutes, then rinse with cool or lukewarm water before shampooing
caution: Use cool or lukewarm water to rinse, not hot, or the egg can start to cook in your hair. Skip this if you have an egg allergy.
cta: Would you try an egg yolk hair mask, or is that one a bit too old-school for you? Let Grandma June know in the comments.
